title: Standing-loss messaging was inconsistent: the first failed 'press him on the Hundred' against Preceptor Aldous printed '(the Ironbound -1)', but a second identical failed press against the same NPC printed no standing-change line at all, even though the DC kept rising as if a cost were still being tracked.
